observation_summary: The compiler failed to correctly identify the least supertype of two record types, resulting in assertion failures in type checking tests.
reasoning_summary: The bug was caused by an incorrect implementation of the 'getLeastSupertype' method within the 'RecordType' class. The implementation attempted to calculate the least supertype by intersecting properties, which is logically incorrect for a union-based supertype operation (it was effectively performing a greatest subtype operation instead). By removing this flawed override, the system correctly falls back to the default 'getLeastSupertype' implementation in the base class, which correctly handles the union of record types as expected by the failing test cases.
